protocol.name: beize_shell_v1

description.summary: what Beize's shell knows of the windows (ADR 0028 §1)

protocol.description:
The compositor tells Beize's shell which windows there are – their app, title and state – and does what the shell asks of them: the dock lists the running apps and brings their windows back, the menu bar names the active app. Modelled on ext-foreign-toplevel-list-v1 (the list) and wlr-foreign-toplevel-management (what the shell asks).
Only the shell is offered the global; the compositor knows it by its unit (os/beize-compositor, trust.rs). Both ends live in Beize's repository and change together: until a version of Beize promises otherwise, the protocol grows without new versions.

interface.name: beize_shell_v1
interface.description: On bind the compositor announces every window there is, in the order they opened, then each new one when it first shows.

request.name: destroy
request.description: The windows announced so far stay valid until destroyed.

event.name: window
event.description: A window is there: its app_id, title and state follow, then done.

interface.name: beize_window_v1
interface.description: Its properties come as events, each set of changes ended by done.

entry.name: active
entry.summary: it has the keyboard; at most one window is active

entry.name: minimized
entry.summary: it is minimized: not on the screen

event.name: app_id
event.description: The app's id (xdg_toplevel.app_id): the name of its desktop file without ".desktop". Empty if the app named none.

description.summary: the changes before it belong together

event.name: closed
event.description: No more events come; the shell destroys the object.

request.name: activate

description.summary: bring the window to the front

request.description: Shows it again if it is minimized, raises it and gives it the keyboard.
